question: Should the shipment be rerouted through the cold-store hub?
context: Protocol C4 permits a vaccine shipment to spend at most 90 minutes above 8 °C. A route is acceptable only if its documented worst-case temperature excursion stays within that limit.

evidence.text: The direct route is delayed by a road closure. The carrier estimates it will be above 8 °C for 130 minutes.
The cold-store hub adds 35 minutes of travel but restores the shipment to 4 °C after 20 minutes above 8 °C.
The destination clinic can accept delivery up to four hours later than planned.

fields.name: excursion
fields.description: worst-case time above 8 °C on the chosen route

fields.name: within_limit
fields.description: does the chosen route satisfy the 90-minute rule
